Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL4649948. Keep only rows with exact measurements (standard_relation '=' and standard_value not null). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to compound_structures. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
